about: Vectors for the draft exchange (DEC-0131, DEC-0133), written by tools/vectors/org-exchange.ts, never by hand. root: organization A's root as members pin it, and as GET .../root answers it nested ({org, issuer, root: {kid, x}}). digest cases: keySetDraftDigest(draft) or authorityDraftDigest(draft), null for none; a key set's digest is sha256: of the RFC 8785 bytes of the set without sig, a list's of the list without digest and signature. rules cases: the FAC-SEM-151 codes and paths an org-key-set-draft or org-authority-draft envelope gives. keySet cases: acceptSignedKeySet(signed, {root, held?, draftDigest?}). authority cases: acceptSignedAuthority(signed, {now, org, keySet, held?, draftDigest?}), keySet the fixture key set. registration cases: verifyRootRegistration(body, {org, issuer, registered, claimValid}) where claimValid(claim) is true exactly for a claim in validClaims; claimChecked says whether claimValid may be called at all (a refused body never reaches it). expected is exactly what the reference returns.

digest.name: a key set's draft: the set without sig
a signed key set is no draft
a key set without revoked has no signing input
a list's draft: the list without digest and signature
a signed list is no draft
a list with a member of its own is no draft

rules.name: the first draft: no base, revision 1
the next draft: revision one above the base
a digest that is not the draft's

keySet.name: the first set, signed as drafted
the next set over the held one, signed as drafted
the held set again: unchanged, no draft needed
a valid set with no draft waiting
a valid set that is not the draft
the verifier's refusal comes first: a set the root did not sign

authority.name: the pending list, signed by an administrator
a list with no draft waiting
a list that is not the draft

registration.name: the root and the owner's credential, on the claim the server showed
a claim the server did not show, checked last
an issuer the first set's root could never carry
a root kid the first set could never carry
an administrator without a credential id
an administrator under a sign-in RP
